audio.text: I just got my first paycheck from my campus job.

options: Congratulations! Are you going to celebrate?
The campus is lovely at this time of year.
The job fair was held in the student center.
I check my email every morning before class.

why.en: Good news → congratulations. B and C repeat "campus" and "job" without responding; D repeats a sound ("check") with a different meaning.
why.tr: İyi haber → tebrik. B ve C "campus" ve "job" kelimelerini cevap vermeden tekrar ediyor; D benzer bir sesi ("check") başka anlamda kullanıyor.
why.es: Buena noticia → felicitación. B y C repiten "campus" y "job" sin responder; D repite un sonido parecido ("check") con otro sentido.
